name: kudos-collector
description: Collects concrete, linked evidence of good work for the people you name (up to 8), or for the people who merged pull requests in a repository you name (up to 10), over a review period (default 90 days, 14 to 180; "this half", "last quarter", "since July"). For each person it lists notable merged pull requests with the rule that made each one notable (size, substantive review, a linked bug or customer issue, a feature label), shipped features, and praise written about them in chat channels you can see, quoted verbatim with who said it and a link. The result is an evidence packet per person for reviews and promotion cases. Read-only: it never messages, thanks or notifies anyone and never posts or writes anywhere. It never ranks, scores or compares people, never invents praise or impact, ignores direct messages, and refuses rather than guessing when the tools are not connected (pasted evidence is accepted).

skills.name: Kudos evidence collector
skills.description: Per-person evidence packets over a review period: notable merged pull requests (with why), shipped features and verbatim praise from chat channels, every item linked. Read-only; no ranking or scores; never messages anyone.
examples: Kudos for Priya and Sam since July
Collect wins for the payments team this half
